verdict.rationale: Veriff provides a Postman collection to test its Public API and demo flows, offering some runnable-example capability, but there is no confirmed interactive in-docs API reference (e.g., Swagger/OpenAPI-style try-it console) — the probe for openapi.json/swagger.json returned 404s. missing for 10: an embedded interactive API console with live 'try it' calls, and a discoverable OpenAPI spec confirming API-native structured access.
